content:
devops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + timeout spike on prod runtime-api cluster in us-west-2. p95 jumped from 120ms -> 1.8s, p99 ~ 5.2s. Error rate 5xx from 0.3% -> 4.7% in last 6m. Trigger: threshold_p99_latency. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/svc-runtime
sara (oncall): acked, looking. I see a deploy finished ~6m ago (deploy/2026-03-15T10:18Z) to canary/blue-3. Rolling log tail now. :eyes:
nate: which route? any correlation with KV-cache evictions?
sara (oncall): early signs on /v1/generate and /v1/stream endpoints. TCP timeouts to gpuhosts show high connect wait. pulling metrics from envoy and the serving runtime.
julia: copying logs from a node (truncated):
```
2026-03-15T10:19:02Z runtime[svc]: request start id=abcd123, route=/v1/generate
2026-03-15T10:19:05Z runtime[svc]: kvcache: miss for model-embed-7
2026-03-15T10:19:09Z runtime[svc]: inference timeout after 3000ms, upstream=gpu01:5050
2026-03-15T10:19:11Z runtime[svc]: 504 gateway timeout to client id=abcd123
```
aman: I can repro a 504 with a single curl to canary host: `curl -i -X POST https://api.prod/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` returns 504 after ~3s consistently right now.
sara (oncall): hypothesis: new kernel selection in this deploy triggers suboptimal path for longer sequences; worker threads block on certain inputs -> backlog -> timeouts. We should check rollout metadata and model variant toggles in the release.
lex: commit hash for deploy is `d4c9f1b` (release/opt-ks). That's the kernel decision refactor.
sara (oncall): causing customer impact: route-level error spike impacting approx 8% of active apps (by route traffic). Pager alert visible. need immediate mitigation. suggestions: quick rollback to previous revision or pin routing to older model-variant. rollback is fastest.
julia: agree. we have confirmation across 4 canary pods and 20% of blue traffic. Rollback plan: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime-api --to-revision=57` on prod-cluster us-west-2, then watch envoy success rate.
sara (oncall): calling rollback now, will annotate incident.
ops-lead: +1 rollback. get a postmortem note in #postmortems after stable. Watch SLA and customer impact.
sara (oncall): running:
```
kubectl --context=prod-west -n runtime rollout undo deployment/runtime-api --to-revision=57
kubectl --context=prod-west -n runtime rollout status deployment/runtime-api --watch
```
(added reaction :thumbsup: from devops-bot)
aman: logs: after issuing undo, a few pods terminate and new pods start pulling old image. ETA ~ 45s for first healthy pod.
nate: keeping an eye on p99 and 5xx dashboards. If rollback doesn't reduce 5xx within 2min we plan to shift traffic to dedicated fallback region (us-east-1) and enable automatic soft-fallback routing.
sara (oncall): update 60s: first pod ready, traffic switching back to previous codepath. p95 down to 180ms, p99 trending down from 5.2s -> 620ms. 5xx rate now 1.1% and dropping.
julia: curl re-test: `HTTP/1.1 200 OK` and body returns quickly.
lex: good catch. root cause likely kernel selection + sequence-length branching not exercised in staging due to different seq distribution. Need more synthetic tests.
ops-lead: can someone post customer-impact brief for SRE lead and CS? include approximate number of affected requests, time window, and which tenants (anonymized) saw errors.
sara (oncall): compiling impact: approx 18:12-18:26 UTC window (~14 minutes from first anomaly until mitigation fully in place). Peak 5xx rate 4.7% at 10:22Z. Estimated ~72k failed requests across prod in that window. We'll add per-tenant breakdown in the follow-up.
aman: filing internal incident ticket IST-2026-112, adding logs, deploy id, rollback command, and heap dumps.
nate: runbook items for oncall handoff to tomorrow's shift: 1) monitor p99 for 2 hours, 2) block merging release/opt-ks until kernel path validated, 3) add sequence-length distribution test to canary.
sara (oncall): handing off to lex for watch window. lex: I'm on. Summary: rollback executed, metrics recovering, customer impact recorded. Next steps: postmortem, reproduce locally with long prompts, add integration test, and consider an automatic fallback if kernel decision fails.
lex: pinging cs-team for customer notifications (low severity email) and product for possible throttling guidance.
ops-lead: thanks team. Please keep the thread updated if anything regresses. I'll schedule the postmortem meeting for 48h.
sara (oncall): closing active pager for now. leaving incident thread open for notes. final note: change flagged to block future CI merges from release/opt-ks until QA signoff. :white_check_mark:
